mechanism: TSMC's steep N2 ramp initially dilutes gross margin, while leading-edge mix, yield learning, productivity gains and across-node capacity optimization can subsequently offset node-startup and overseas-fab dilution. The economic mechanism is learning-curve and mix economics inside a leading-edge foundry, distinct from lithography-equipment scarcity.
claim: As frozen after TSMC's 15 October 2026 Q3 disclosure, TSMC is a bounded fundamental candidate for durable earnings-power expansion if N2 adoption remains commercially strong and productivity/yield/capacity optimization offsets the documented N2-ramp and overseas-fab margin dilution. No stock-return, fair-value or positive-alpha claim is made.
prediction: Without inspecting subsequent market outcomes, later company disclosures should show N2 becoming a larger economically productive share of wafer revenue, gross-margin dilution from N2/overseas ramps becoming bounded rather than structurally worsening, and productivity/across-node optimization visibly offsetting part of the ramp burden while advanced-node demand remains commercially firm.
falsification_scope: Falsify G1 if N2 ramp economics show persistent or worsening dilution without credible productivity/yield offset, advanced-node demand weakens materially, overseas-fab structural dilution overwhelms normalized foundry economics, or customer/technology transitions undermine utilization and pricing power. Security valuation can independently invalidate investability without falsifying the operating mechanism.

decision_map.ticker_context: 2330.TW / TSM identity only; no market outcome inspected

facts: 2nm was 8% of wafer revenue in Q3
7nm and below were 79% of wafer revenue
Q3 gross margin fell 130bp sequentially primarily due to initial 2nm ramp
Q4 margin pressure is attributed to continued 2nm ramp and overseas-fab dilution, partly offset by productivity and across-node capacity optimization

active_disconfirmation: N2 is currently a margin headwind, not proof of margin expansion.
Overseas-fab dilution may be durable and larger than optimization gains.
AI/customer demand can slow or be misforecast.
Advanced-node revenue mix can rise while returns deteriorate if depreciation and operating costs rise faster.
Geopolitical concentration and overseas expansion can impair economics.
A correct operating thesis does not imply an attractive equity valuation.

legacy_distinctness.note: Existing frozen ASML fundamental candidates concern equipment scarcity and installed-base/service economics; this candidate concerns foundry node-ramp learning, mix and structural dilution.

validator_focus: bound N2 ramp dilution versus productivity/yield learning
separate overseas-fab structural dilution from temporary ramp costs
establish normalized capex/depreciation and free-cash-flow implications
keep valuation and any market outcome closed until separately authorized
